description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlIpc component, specifically testing the Ping functionality via IPC. It defines a test fixture class 'ControlIpcPingTest' with multiple test cases to verify ping acknowledgments, channel disconnections, reconnections, failure scenarios, and handle ID validation.

classes.name: ControlIpcPingTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from ControlIpcTestBase, designed to test the Ping functionality over IPC, including setup, teardown, and utility methods for creating ping events.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a PingEvent with control handle and ID set.
